limitations: All six original A/A screens failed: descriptive observations, no qualified speedup or FPS claim.
Engine and migration sessions are separate. Their changed pure-r186 regime is unresolved; do not pool or subtract across them.
Callback timing covers disjoint Viewer.animate and three native GUI callbacks, not whole-browser CPU, GPU time, or frame completion. Timing instrumentation overhead is uncalibrated.
PNG bytes/dimensions and stored raw-pixel SHA equality are checked; this verifier does not recreate WebGL readPixels.

Native oracle pages retain source inventories and exact HTML; captureSources is disabled there. Timed pages retain served JavaScript/Wasm bytes. Existing build hashes are evidence, not an independent rebuild certification.
Dedicated matched-JS A/A, startup/memory/long interaction, broader content/behavior and cross-device/day qualification remain unperformed.
